convert_mot_to_reid: convert MOT dataset into ReID dataset with configurable visibility threshold and per-person image limits
run_mot2reid_conversion: run MOT to ReID conversion specifying input MOT data path and output ReID dataset directory
filter_mot_person_instances: filter MOT ground truth annotations by class id and visibility threshold to extract pedestrian ReID crops
split_reid_dataset: split extracted ReID person images into training and validation sets with configurable validation proportion
downsample_reid_ids: downsample person instances exceeding max images per person and filter out those below minimum image count
